verdict.stance: Neutral / Maturity Wall Cleared to 2032-33 Amid Heavy Infrastructure Strikes
verdict.summary: Naftogaz completed a landmark July 2026 restructuring of its €1.2bn Kondor Finance Eurobonds (>90% consent), pushing €695m to Jan-2032 and $584m to Jan-2033 at 8.95% coupons and eliminating near-term refinancing cliffs. War damage (229 strikes in 2025), winter gas import needs, and PSO receivables keep fundamental risk elevated.

positives: Jul-26 Eurobond restructuring cleared all principal maturities until Jan-2032 / Jan-2033.
Strategic monopoly over Ukrainian domestic gas production, storage, and winter heating supply.
100% Ukrainian sovereign ownership with Western IFI/EBRD winter gas financing support.
negatives: Severe physical infrastructure vulnerability (229 Russian attacks in 2025; FY25 NI fell to UAH 5.83bn).
PSO working-capital absorption and state tariff arrears.
NBU FX transfer constraints on cross-border debt service.

background.business_overview: Ukraine's national oil and gas company (upstream UkrGasVydobuvannya, gas storage, trading).
background.asset_perimeter: Domestic gas production, underground gas storage (largest in Europe), oil/gas transit and supply.
